description: For distinct \(p,q\), the literal \(p\) is pure in \([(p\lor q)]\), although \(p=0,q=1\) is a model; setting \(p=1\) gives the empty CNF, which is true also under the all-zero valuation where the original is false.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.pure_not_forced.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p q : α) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
  have Γ := [[{ atom := p, positive := true }, { atom := q, positive := true }]];
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Pure { atom := p, positive := true } Γ ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models (Function.update (fun x => false) q true) Γ ∧
      Function.update (fun x => false) q true p = false ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p true Γ = [] ∧
          ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models (fun x => false) Γ
